capacity: USD 50,000/person/year needs only ID; above that, transaction documents
pros: Lowest documented all-in cost of any lawful route; Fully lawful and audit-proof when the purpose is genuine; No third-party counterparty risk
cons: Requires a bona fide current-account purpose; savings with no qualifying purpose are not automatically eligible; Bank reviews purpose consistency between purchase and remittance (S03); Intermediary and U.S. receiving-bank fees are not published: UNVERIFIED

capacity: Same legal limits as the counter channel
pros: Same published tariff, no branch visit; Rate and fee displayed before confirmation
cons: App limits can be lower than the legal limit; the bank's own cap must be confirmed; Some purposes may still require a branch review

method: Annual convenience amount, used year by year
pros: Minimal paperwork; Spreads the s988 currency gain across tax years, which can lower the marginal rate; Lowest fee volatility
cons: Very slow: 8 years for USD 400,000; Each year's conversion date is unknown in advance, so the FX outcome is not locked; The convenience amount can be adjusted by SAFE (S02)

method: Documented current-account remittance above the convenience amount
capacity: No legal ceiling; authenticity review applies
pros: The only route that can lawfully move a large sum quickly; No artificial splitting needed
cons: Documents must be real; fabricated documents trigger penalty exposure (S08); Bank discretion: the same documents may be accepted or refused by different branches; Genuine accumulated savings without a qualifying current-account purpose may still be refused

capacity: Staged: first half, then half of remainder after 1 year, rest after 2 years
pros: Explicit legal channel for moving a whole estate, not just USD 50,000; Predictable staged schedule
cons: Requires emigrating and cancelling Chinese hukou; a U.S. citizen who never held mainland hukou generally does not qualify; Tax certificate mandatory - the tax position must be settled first; Staged payouts mean the FX rate is not locked; One application only, for the entire amount

capacity: One application per deceased person; one-off or instalments
pros: The only route designed for a foreign-citizen heir; Can be a single payout
cons: Applies to inherited assets, not your own savings; Tax certificate and notarised documents required; Case-by-case review; no published fee

method: Company profit / dividend repatriation (if you own the entity)
legality: Lawful only if the CNY belongs to a company you own
capacity: Requires capital-account registration and tax clearance
pros: Can move large amounts in a single transaction; Fully documented corporate route
cons: Only works if you genuinely own the company - otherwise it is a disguised personal transfer; Corporate and withholding tax apply before remittance; Accounting and audit costs

capacity: <=USD 5,000 no permit; 5,000-10,000 bank permit; >10,000 not permitted in principle
pros: Physical settlement, no counterparty; No wire fee
cons: Hard ceiling of USD 10,000 per person per trip; 40 trips would be needed for USD 400,000; Physical loss/theft risk and insurance cost; Cash conversion uses the worse cash rate; Structuring repeated trips near the limit is exactly the conduct S04/S05 targets

method: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal on a mainland bank card
pros: No paperwork, immediate access; Useful for living costs rather than a lump sum
cons: RMB 100,000/year is far below the target; USD 400,000 is impossible; ATM operator and issuer fees, plus a worse cash rate: UNVERIFIED; Borrowing or lending cards to evade the cap is prohibited (S07)

capacity: No conversion to USD cash; consumption only
reaches_400k: No - it is spending, not conversion
pros: No wiring, no cash limit; Does not consume the convenience amount (S07)
cons: You receive goods or services, not dollars in your account; Cannot fund a U.S. bank account; Merchant/issuer FX markup: UNVERIFIED

method: Transfer to your own offshore account (HK/other) then convert
legality: Lawful only if the outbound leg is itself lawful
capacity: Outbound leg subject to the same SAFE rules
pros: Access to deeper offshore FX liquidity; Onshore/offshore rates can differ
cons: Does not bypass anything: the binding constraint is the outbound leg; Two sets of fees; Onshore-offshore spread is market data, not a published official rate: UNVERIFIED

method: Borrowing other people's quotas / splitting (分拆)
reaches_400k: No - it is the violation itself
cons: Explicitly prohibited by Huifa [2015] No.49 (S04); Watch-list status for the year of listing plus 2 more years (S04); Evasion penalties up to 30% of the amount, 30%-100% if serious (S08)

method: Underground bank / informal exchanger (地下钱庄)
pros: None - quoted 'no tax' rates are not a legal basis
cons: Confiscation plus fine up to 30%-100% of the amount (S08); Counterparty and seizure risk; U.S. tax and FBAR duties are unaffected by how the money moved
Explicitly illegal financial activity (S12); Banks and payment institutions must refuse to service it (S12); U.S. consequences stack on top: s988 gain plus FBAR/8938 reporting
Fine up to 30% of the amount, 30%-100% if serious (S08); Destroys the audit trail you need for U.S. reporting; Potential criminal exposure (S08)

method: Structuring sub-threshold transfers to avoid reporting
cons: Prohibited on both sides (S04, S19); Seizure and civil or criminal penalties (S19); Watch-list consequences (S04)
